_doc: FAILURE-AUDIT-1 + FAILURE-RESOLVE-1: live detectors for every failure mode in doctrine/registers.json (python3 -m foundation failure_audit --check fails when one has none), run daily by .github/workflows/failure-audit.yml and on demand. Read by foundation/failure_audit.py. A failing detector files queue item docs/issues/Q-AUDIT-<id>.json, which the executor takes; a passing one closes it with evidence. Kinds: command (argv, no shell), http (https reading), probe (file: or grep: spec).

detectors.root_cause: the seed heartbeat cannot boot from this repository alone (path, migration or tick step error)
detectors.remedy: Run python3 -m foundation selfhost, read tick errors, fix the portable core, add a regression test.

detectors.root_cause: a foundation check regressed or a test depends on the host
detectors.remedy: Fix the root cause in code or make the test host-independent; never delete the failing test.

detectors.root_cause: the seed worker (tick, measure, executor, lane) regressed
detectors.remedy: Fix the seed worker; every probe kind keeps a test.

detectors.root_cause: the vision or its enforcement was edited out of one entry point
detectors.remedy: Restore the system test in the drifted file; keep docs/doctrine/VISION.md and its seed copy identical.

detectors.root_cause: the public worker is down or misrouted
detectors.remedy: Check the last deploy-site run and route; canary revert should already have acted.

run: import subprocess,sys; r=[subprocess.run(c).returncode for c in (['python3','scripts/build_site_roadmap.py','--check'],['python3','-m','foundation','pins','--check'])]; sys.exit(1 if any(r) else 0)
detectors.root_cause: a public claim is not linked to code, proof or a probe-backed issue, or site/pins.js is stale
detectors.remedy: Write the missing probe or code link; run python3 -m foundation pins --apply.

detectors.root_cause: the deployed seed runtime of Ultrastable stopped ticking or its D1/cron binding broke
detectors.remedy: Read the runtime's last tick_runs.errors with wrangler d1 execute; redeploy with scripts/deploy_tenant.py; check the cron schedule.

detectors.root_cause: the report lint no longer rejects a report that ends in a question, menu or approval request
detectors.remedy: Restore the hand-back rule in foundation/directive.py lint; a report states the decision and its assumption.

detectors.root_cause: a queue item was closed without evidence, or lost its owner, trigger or probe
detectors.remedy: Give the item its evidence or reopen it; python3 -m foundation queue --check names each one.

detectors.root_cause: the loop-breaker no longer mutates on the second identical failure or opens an incident on the third
detectors.remedy: Restore directive.loop_breaker; a fourth attempt of the same fix is never allowed.

detectors.root_cause: a blocker is accepted with one surface tested
detectors.remedy: Restore the blocker log rule in directive.scorecard: every surface and its evidence.

detectors.root_cause: a required fact left the repository or the directive text drifted (write-back skipped)
detectors.remedy: Write the fact back to its file in doctrine/durable-facts.json; never keep it in tool memory.

detectors.root_cause: the lane treats 'no required check is red' as green
detectors.remedy: Restore greenguard.notGreen in the tick lane and sweeper: a merge needs a successful checks run on the head commit.

detectors.root_cause: the lane no longer aborts a half-finished rebase before adopting main
detectors.remedy: Restore the LANE-REBASE-1 block in scripts/lane.sh: abort, reset to origin/main, redo the idempotent adoption.

detectors.root_cause: the regenerate workflow pushes once to a moving branch
detectors.remedy: Restore REGEN-PUSH-1: fetch, reset to main, regenerate, push again, up to 4 tries, never force.

detectors.root_cause: an item about another repository's CI is takeable here
detectors.remedy: Restore executor.foreign_cifail so the item leaves the takeable set; ciwatch closes it by probe.

detectors.root_cause: scripts/lane.sh no longer runs the merge audit, so a merge without a green checks run goes unfiled
detectors.remedy: Restore the mergeaudit step in scripts/lane.sh; it files Q-CIFAIL-mergeaudit-N for every such merge.

detectors.root_cause: a failure mode lost its detector, or a recorded failure has no open Q-AUDIT item in the queue
detectors.remedy: Add the detector to doctrine/detectors.json, or run python3 -m foundation failure_audit --run so the finding is filed.

detectors.root_cause: an owner ask (gate, needs-you item, /owner link) was emitted without an attempt in every surface class
detectors.remedy: Run python3 -m foundation pathfinder --resolve ASK_ID; the first working route closes the ask, otherwise the recorded attempts are the exhaustion proof.

detectors.root_cause: a wait on a person entered the system as a document, card, report or unmerged PR
detectors.remedy: Take the input as given: build the consumer, let the lane merge and deploy, or reduce it to one identity-bound gate with a default in effect.

detectors.root_cause: a hotspot, neglected area, stopped loop or repeated failure stood in the series for several runs and nothing corrected it
detectors.remedy: Take the open Q-TEMPORAL items for the finding; python3 -m foundation pathfinder --regress lists the commits since a loop last worked.

detectors.root_cause: a dependency manifest has no Dependabot entry
detectors.remedy: Add the ecosystem and directory to .github/dependabot.yml.

detectors.root_cause: a root-cause class is malformed, or one escalated with no open Q-ROOT item
detectors.remedy: Fix doctrine/rootcauses.json or let python3 -m foundation rootcause --run file the item.

detectors.root_cause: an item outlived its written SLA because no loop owned its state
detectors.remedy: Read the breach list; the sweeper supersedes PRs, the executor takes the issue at p0. Fix the loop that left it, never raise the limit.

detectors.root_cause: source names a model id after the provider retired it
detectors.remedy: Run python3 -m foundation yearsim --probe model-retirement, read the drill evidence, fix the recovery code it exercises (YEAR-SIM-1), add a regression test.

detectors.root_cause: generated and append-only files edited on both sides
detectors.remedy: Run python3 -m foundation yearsim --probe merge-conflict, read the drill evidence, fix the recovery code it exercises (YEAR-SIM-1), add a regression test.

detectors.root_cause: a hard cap instead of a soft throttle
detectors.remedy: Run python3 -m foundation yearsim --probe ai-quota, read the drill evidence, fix the recovery code it exercises (YEAR-SIM-1), add a regression test.

detectors.root_cause: no loop updates dependencies
detectors.remedy: Run python3 -m foundation yearsim --probe dependency-break, read the drill evidence, fix the recovery code it exercises (YEAR-SIM-1), add a regression test.

detectors.root_cause: one clock with no second host
detectors.remedy: Run python3 -m foundation yearsim --probe scheduler-silent, read the drill evidence, fix the recovery code it exercises (YEAR-SIM-1), add a regression test.

detectors.root_cause: the say-do module, its data or its executor guard is missing or stale
detectors.remedy: Run python3 -m foundation saydo --run --apply, then --check; restore the SAY-DO-1 guard in foundation/executor.py if it is gone.

detectors.root_cause: the daily intent-yield run stopped, errored, or its parser lost the owner's directives
detectors.remedy: Read the last run's error in ops/intent-yield/state.json; dispatch .github/workflows/intent-yield.yml, or fix the parser in foundation/intentyield.py when the directive format changed, with a test.

detectors.root_cause: the template cannot admit a system: a probe, import or kernel path regressed
detectors.remedy: Run python3 -m foundation seedadmit --probe, read the failing component, fix the seed (never the kit's bar), add a regression test (SEED-ADMIT-1).

detectors.root_cause: an admitted seed was never deployed, or its Worker stopped answering /health
detectors.remedy: Dispatch .github/workflows/deploy-workers.yml (it runs deploy/deploy-seed.mjs); read the failing row in ops/deploys.jsonl; fix the seed, never the probe (SEED-DEPLOY-1).

detectors.root_cause: the latest e2e seed launch failed or is stale, or a seeded repository failed its launch
detectors.remedy: Read ops/seed-launches.jsonl failed_stages, fix the seed or bootstrap stage in seed/, add a regression test, dispatch seed-launch.yml.

detectors.root_cause: a seed was deployed with a database and a cron only: no source-control credential and no repository of its own, so every loop that reads or writes a repository fails and the seed stays at ticking
detectors.remedy: Read the blocking loops in the seed's /health ignition field. Give the generated seed its own repository and a token scoped to that repository only, bound by deploy/deploy-seed.mjs, then let its loops record beats; never accept /health 200 as autonomy and never lower the stage (SEED-AUTONOMY-1).

detectors.root_cause: a tenant worker's clock stopped, or a part it reports (its evidence search, reader or feed) says ok false while the clock still ticks
detectors.remedy: Read the tenant's /health and its last beats' reports (error samples per source); fix the tenant repository by PR; the tick's tenant-deploy step ships it.

detectors.root_cause: a published page is not bound to any loop that regenerates it, so it stopped changing
detectors.remedy: Bind the named page to a loop (generated block, feed or live read) in the system that serves it; never edit its text only to change it.

detectors.root_cause: a generator that feeds a public page stopped running, or its output never lands on main
detectors.remedy: Find the generator named in the file header; make the workflow that runs it land the file through scripts/land_data.py, then rerun.

detectors.root_cause: a scheduled workflow fails every run or stopped being scheduled, and no check watches it
detectors.remedy: Read the failing run's log, fix the root cause in that repository, and dispatch it once to prove it is green.

detectors.root_cause: workflow runs sit at action_required, or an issue made with the built-in token triggered nothing
detectors.remedy: silentfail --actions approves or dispatches the run and dispatches the issue loop; fix the repository approval setting if it recurs

detectors.root_cause: Worker source imports a Node builtin without nodejs_compat or a file that does not exist
detectors.remedy: Remove the import or add the compat flag in the worker's wrangler file; the check runs before merge in checks

detectors.root_cause: a new module duplicates an existing one
detectors.remedy: Extend the existing module; if distinct, add the pair to overlap.distinct in doctrine/silent-failures.json with the reason in the commit

detectors.root_cause: a public surface no longer reads what the code says it serves (zero changes, a wrong claim, a dead page)
detectors.remedy: Fix the producer, not the reading; the ledger ops/live-verify.jsonl is what every done claim cites

detectors.root_cause: a loop stopped writing its ledger
detectors.remedy: Find the loop's workflow run, fix its trigger, add a second route

detectors.root_cause: an incident matches no silent-failure class, or a class lost its detector
detectors.remedy: Add the class with a detector to doctrine/silent-failures.json

detectors.root_cause: a code-agent model route fails and nothing falls to the next rung
detectors.remedy: Fix the ladder in foundation/agents.py; probe each rung

detectors.root_cause: a repository's live visibility differs from org/repos.json or doctrine/tenant-repos.json
detectors.remedy: The tick's repo-visibility loop sets it back; if it reports refused, give the administration app access to that repository.

detectors.root_cause: crons exceed the plan's account limit, a live schedule is undeclared, or a tenant clock has no pulse route
detectors.remedy: Declare the schedule in doctrine/topology.json and give the tenant a pulse URL the tick calls.

detectors.root_cause: a push on main matched a workflow's paths and started no run
detectors.remedy: The detector dispatches the workflow; if dispatch is refused, the workflow needs workflow_dispatch.

detectors.root_cause: a bot commits without comparing trees
detectors.remedy: Find the committing step on the named branch and compare its tree with the head before committing (MERGENOW-NOOP-1 pattern).

detectors.root_cause: lane items are no longer closed by their PR's state
detectors.remedy: Restore LANE-FILED-FAIL-1 in foundation/contracts.py.

detectors.root_cause: the Cloudflare credential reaches another account than the topology names
detectors.remedy: Re-issue the workflow secrets from the topology's account through the deploy route; never paste the retired id.

detectors.root_cause: a knowledge-graph row is built but its probe answers no nodes
detectors.remedy: Run the tenant's graph step and set the row back to pending until its probe shows nodes.

detectors.root_cause: checks no longer refuse a deploy verified only by the tick's /health
detectors.remedy: Restore the handoff-lint step in checks.yml.

detectors.root_cause: the UI/UX run no longer rolls a stale visual baseline
detectors.remedy: Restore --roll-baseline in uiux.yml.

detectors.root_cause: a seed DOI of the Replication Ledger was never checked at Crossref after the grace beats, or its check failed
detectors.remedy: The ledger's beat checks BEAT.CROSSREF seed DOIs per beat; the 503 body names unchecked_dois and failed. A failed DOI is corrected in instances/replication-ledger/worker/data/findings.json (node worker/cli.mjs verify); an unchecked one means beats are erroring at Crossref (GET /api/beats).

detectors.root_cause: the seed kernel needs something no code in it produces (instruction import, wrangler placeholder, undeclared secret, migration collision, workflow with no trigger)
detectors.remedy: Run python3 -m foundation bootproof, fix the seed tree or declare the item in doctrine/bootproof.json with its degrade and acquire route (BOOTPROOF-1).

detectors.root_cause: a probe reads empty, stale, unscored or vacuous data as fine, so a failure passes until the owner sees it
detectors.remedy: Fix the check named in the finding at its root (the measurer, not the reading) and add a test that reproduces the owner-found failure.
